goal: Per-location printable Review QR that resolves through the RepWorth-owned QR redirect (/q/<businessId>) to that location's Google write-review link, with every successful redirect counted as a qr_scan_redirected analytics event.
non_goals: Contact capture or per-customer targeting — every customer scans the same code (roadmap Phase 0 lock)
Sentiment gating or any interstitial rating page — the hop is a straight 302 to Google (roadmap Phase 0 lock)
Opaque or rotatable QR tokens — the business UUID is the key; re-pointing is server-side and needs no reprint
PDF generation dependency — browser print of the print view covers PDF
Short or vanity domain for the QR URL — NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL is the host
Per-QR campaign variants or scan attribution beyond the single per-location event
New feature flag or env var
Rate limiting on the redirect route — Vercel WAF owns the edge (same posture as /r/google)
user_visible_behavior: Owner sees a new 'Review QR' settings section (SettingsSidebar entry) listing every non-archived location with a QR preview — visible regardless of the multi-location flag
Owner downloads a print-quality PNG (~2048px) per location
Owner opens a minimal print view (business name + 'Scan to leave us a review' + QR) and prints via the browser
A location whose google_place_id is missing or a legacy hex CID shows an explanatory card instead of a QR
Scanning the QR 302-redirects the customer to https://search.google.com/local/writereview?placeid=<place id>

The scanner gets a branded 'link unavailable' page (scanner-appropriate copy, no dashboard CTA) when the account is pending_payment or cancelled, the location is archived or missing, or the place id is not canonical — never a redirect in those states
Each successful redirect records one qr_scan_redirected analytics event (account_id + business_id properties), shipped to PostHog by the existing AnalyticsDispatchPoller
invariants: Redirect gate is a named predicate subscriptionAllowsQrRedirect in src/lib/shared/subscription-status.ts admitting exactly {active, trialing, past_due} — never a raw status comparison (invariant #11)

The destination URL is CONSTRUCTED from an isPlaceId-validated google_place_id (src/lib/reviews/url-parser.ts), never read from a stored URL — hex CIDs are refused (dispatch.ts buildReviewLink precedent); no open-redirect is possible
The analytics insert runs AFTER resolve, best-effort in its own try/catch — a failed insert never blocks or fails the redirect
Owner-facing QR endpoints are account-scoped via the owner-route precedent; the public redirect route reads only by validated UUID and leaks no tenant data and no error details
Vercel = UI only (invariant #1): the redirect is one short DB read + insert + 302; no worker code changes
The qr_scan_redirected registry entry (events.ts) and the analytics_events CHECK widening (migration 115) land in the same PR — the drift guard requires it
Cache-Control: no-store on every redirect-route response (/r/google precedent)
Route handlers orchestrate only — resolve/eligibility logic lives in src/lib/locations/review-qr.ts with the sql client passed in (invariant #15)
edge_cases: Legacy hex-CID place id (migration 007 rows): isPlaceId fails, owner card explains, scanner gets the unavailable page
Archived location (archived_at IS NOT NULL): unavailable page; un-archiving restores the SAME printed QR without reprint
Malformed or unknown businessId in the URL: unavailable page, no DB error leak
Analytics insert failure: redirect still 302s; failure is logged
Offboarding purge deleted the business row: unavailable page
pending_payment account: owner can see and print the QR from settings, but the live redirect serves the unavailable page until the subscription activates
HEAD requests and link prefetchers count as scans in v1 — accepted noise, documented in the module header
existing_patterns_to_follow: src/app/r/google/[responseId]/route.ts — hardened public redirect, unavailable page, no-store
src/lib/solicitation/dispatch.ts:740-774 — write-review URL construction + isPlaceId validation + loud refusal of hex CIDs
src/app/api/_shared/channels/start.ts — server-side qrcode generation (dependency already installed)
src/lib/locations/owner-route.ts + repo.ts — owner-scoped location access and archived_at semantics
src/lib/analytics/enqueue.ts + events.ts — durable event insert, event_key idempotency, registry allowlist
Migrations 069/102 — precedent for widening the analytics_events event_name CHECK
tests_to_add: redirects an active-subscription location with a canonical place id to the Google write-review URL
returns the unavailable page for a cancelled or pending_payment account
returns the unavailable page for an archived location
returns the unavailable page when google_place_id is a legacy hex CID
returns the unavailable page for a malformed or unknown business id
still redirects when the analytics insert fails
records a qr_scan_redirected analytics event on a successful redirect
returns only the caller's account locations from getOwnerReviewQrLocations
subscriptionAllowsQrRedirect admits active, trialing and past_due only
refuses to build a review link for a non-canonical place id
rollback_plan: Migration 115 is additive (CHECK widening only). Down path: delete qr_scan_redirected rows, then restore the previous CHECK constraint. Feature back-out: revert the PR — routes and UI disappear; no printed codes exist in the wild pre-launch. Staging Supabase first, prod in lockstep at promotion, per the deployment runbook.
observability: qr_scan_redirected rows in analytics_events and the matching PostHog events — scans flatlining is the break signal
One structured log line per unavailable-page serve with a reason code (bad_id, not_found, archived, subscription, bad_place_id) — a spike in one reason names the failure
Analytics-insert failures logged loudly (never swallowed silently) so redirect-vs-event divergence is visible
